comment: V4 v0.7.0: per-binding native-implementation dashboard. Tracks which v0.7.0 evaluator-surface features each binding's native path covers vs which routes through the libcx C ABI. At v0.7.0 all 5 active bindings are C-ABI-passthrough by design (per ADR 0022 §D8 binding tiering). This file is the v0.7.x / v0.8.0 native-port roadmap.

v.comment: V is the native reference. Every feature is native by definition.

python.comment: Native Python parser for data-bin + AST surfaces; eval/diff/hash/canonical via libcx FFI. Arrow + Parquet via pyarrow C-Data bridge.

go.comment: Native Go parser for data-bin + AST + emitters. Eval surface via cgo + libcx.

rust.comment: Native data-bin + AST; everything else routes through libcx FFI via ensure_thread().

typescript.comment: koffi FFI to libcx for most surfaces. Arrow + Parquet via apache-arrow JS IPC bridge (W7 / X6) — composes with libcx C-Data export.

csharp.reason: Not in 5-binding parity matrix; not built/tested at v0.7.0

v0_7_x_native_port_roadmap.comment: v0.7.x / v0.8.0 candidates for native-implementation expansion. Order: data-bin → emitters → eval (the latter is large and binding-specific).
priority_order: typescript.cx_eval (porting CXL evaluator to TS — substantial)
